output.review_comment: The implementation correctly addresses all three requirements from the docstring: (1) preserves mixed-case words like "iPhone" through early detection before small-word checking, (2) ensures last words are capitalized even if they're small words, and (3) handles subtitle capitalization after colons. The logic is well-structured with the mixed-case check first (correct priority), proper punctuation handling, and clear conditional flow. The three rules implemented are standard title-case conventions, not test-specific quirks. All 9 tests passing confirms the fix works as intended.
